what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in Malaysia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4010 Pakistani refugees in Malaysia, 4.4% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan in every year from 2007 to 2025, with the TTP and Lashkar-e-Islam among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group in some years since 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4135, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Malaysia.
These are year-end totals for Malaysia only, reported to UNHCR.
